name: heild
description: Monorepo do backend da Heild (branch backend). O app (app/) continua com o próprio package.json e lockfile.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @heild/servidor && npm run typecheck -w @heild/processos && npm run typecheck -w @heild/integrantes
scripts.lint: app/node_modules/.bin/oxlint -c app/.oxlintrc.json --deny-warnings pacotes/integrantes/src pacotes/integrantes/testes pacotes/integrantes/scripts pacotes/processos/src pacotes/dominio/src servidor/src servidor/test app/src/nucleo/banco app/src/nucleo/permissoes/leitura.ts app/src/nucleo/permissoes/ferramentas-entidade.ts app/src/nucleo/consulta.ts
scripts.contratos:conferir: npm run contratos -w @heild/servidor && git diff --exit-code -- servidor/contratos
